subject: Post-demo recap: success gates, evaluation approach, and timeline
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Tom Baxter <tom.baxter@finpath.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap: success gates, evaluation approach, and timeline

Tom — thanks again for the demo time earlier. Quick recap and a proposal for the trial/POC so we can lock dates and owners. I kept this intentionally concise so we can align quickly.

Call highlights
- Goal: validate Redwood inference for FinPath question-answer and document summarization flows in production-ish conditions.
- Primary concerns: relevance/accuracy, latency at P95, cost per call, and data handling (PII masking & auditability).

Proposed success gates (high level)
1) Relevance: automated metrics on your held-out dataset (see rubric) + human pass-rate >= 85% on sampled responses.
2) Latency: P95 <= 450ms in shadow mode across target traffic mix.
3) Throughput/stability: no sustained errors > 0.5% during a 2-week shadow window.
4) Safety & privacy: zero high-severity safety incidents; all logs masked per your compliance needs.

Evaluation approach (two-stage)
- Stage A (offline evals, 7 business days once dataset available): Redwood runs batch evaluation against your labeled set and returns metric table + ranked failure cases.
- Stage B (online shadowing, 10 business days): non-productive traffic routed to shadow instance; outputs logged to secure project bucket (masked) and human sampling performed.

Ownership & inputs
- FinPath (owner: Tom): provide a 500–1,000 example held-out dataset with labels/scoring guidance, and security checklist responses.
- Redwood (owner: Rachel / Karthik): run offline evals, deploy shadow instance in your staging VPC, and produce final pass/fail report and recommended config tweaks.

Next steps (proposed)
1. You confirm dataset availability and any additional success metrics by EOD Thu (9/10).
2. FinPath delivers dataset and any labeled instructions (target: by Mon 9/13).
3. Redwood completes offline evals within 7 business days of receiving dataset and proposes shadow start date.
4. Kickoff call to finalize SOW and timeline (I proposed dates below).

Attachments: Redwood-eval-rubric-v1.md (rubric + metric definitions), Trial-setup-outline.pdf (ops checklist).

Proposed kickoff windows: Sep 15–17 or Sep 20–22 (we can adjust).

Thanks — I’ll stand up a short kickoff invite once you confirm dates.

—
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap: success gates, evaluation approach, and timeline

Rachel — appreciate the clear note. We’re aligned on the two-stage approach and the success gates look reasonable. A few clarifications and asks from our side: 

- Dataset: we can assemble ~800 labeled QA pairs + 200 unlabelled examples for human eval. Target to deliver by Mon 9/13.
- Security/compliance: before we start shadowing, we need a short SOC2 evidence pack (or pointer to the SOC2 report) and confirmation of at-rest encryption for shadow logs. Can you confirm where that will live?
- Human evals: we prefer a minimum of 3 raters per sampled item and a pass threshold of 80% concordance to be conservative.

Also attaching our internal pilot requirements doc (FinPath-Pilot-Requirements.docx) — it has some details about PII policies and redaction rules.

On the timeline: Sep 15 start for shadowing is OK if offline evals finish by Sep 14. If you need the dataset earlier to meet the 7-business-day offline window, please flag.

Thanks — Tom
Tom Baxter
Head of Product, FinPath
tom.baxter@finpath.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Tom Baxter <tom.baxter@finpath.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap: success gates, evaluation approach, and timeline

Thanks — good points, Tom. A few technical clarifications and a proposed concrete rubric so everyone is aligned before we start.

Offline vs Online (what we’ll measure)
- Offline (batch): precision/recall (or F1) on labeled examples, ROUGE-L where applicable, response time simulated at expected seq length, and safety classifier pass rate. We’ll produce a ranked failure list with counterexamples.
- Online shadowing: P95 latency and error rate under realistic request pacing; human sampling of 200 items stratified by vertical and complexity.

Proposed grading rubric (pass thresholds)
- Automated metrics: F1 >= 0.78 or ROUGE-L > 0.65 (depending on task), safety classifier false positive rate < 2%.
- Latency: P95 <= 450ms (we’ll report P50/P95/P99).
- Human eval pass-rate: >= 85% overall acceptability; additional task-specific pass-rates will be flagged in the report.
- Operational: sustained error rate < 0.5% during the shadow window; no critical security findings.

Human evaluation design
- Sample size: 200 items (Tom suggested this is fine).
- Raters: 3 independent raters per item, majority vote decides acceptability. Dispute cases flagged for product review.

Deliverables and timing
- On dataset receipt (owner: FinPath): Redwood will kick off offline evals and deliver results + ranked failure cases within 7 business days.
- After offline sign-off: we’ll schedule a 10-business-day shadow run and deliver a final pass/fail report and recommended model/config adjustments.

Security evidence & logs
- SOC2: we will share our attestation and a redacted SOC2 summary document via secure link.
- Shadow logs: stored in an encrypted S3 bucket in your staging VPC; we’ll apply the redaction rules you provided.

I’ve uploaded a working spreadsheet with the metric definitions and an example scoring sheet: FinPath-eval-criteria-v2.xlsx (link in the folder below).

On the kickoff windows, Sep 15 works for us assuming the dataset arrives by Sep 13.

—
Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Post-demo recap: success gates, evaluation approach, and timeline

Karthik, Rachel — that sounds good. We’ll bundle the labeled set and the additional 200 sample items and aim to deliver by Mon 2026-09-13.

Regarding SOC2: I can share a pointer to the FinPath compliance contact (they’ll provide any extra details you need), but for now we need confirmation that you can host shadow logs encrypted and that access can be restricted to the named Redwood accounts.

We’re targeting Sep 15 as the shadow start date contingent on the offline evals completing by Sep 14 — please confirm once you have the dataset and we’ll lock the kickoff time.

Thanks — Tom

- I’ve attached a draft SOW for the pilot (SOW-FinPath-Pilot-Sep2026.pdf) and will send a calendar invite for the kickoff on Sep 15 at 10:00 AM PT.

If anything changes on your side, ping me and we’ll adjust. Looking forward to getting this started.
